title: Shared link
description: Your broker shared this information with you. Here you will see the policy and its installments.
noPermission: You don't have access to share this item.

dialog.title: Share link
dialog.description: Create a secure link to {{entity}}, no sign-in required. Ready to send over WhatsApp.

refusal.caseFileInsurer: A case file is shared with the insured only; share the policy with the insurer instead.
refusal.inquiryInsured: A status inquiry is shared with the insurer only.

audience.label: Who are you sharing it with?
audience.insuredHint: They will see the policy and its installments, with how to pay each one.
audience.insurerHint: They will see the policy and its installments, and can report their payment status.

perm.label: What they can do
perm.can_payHint: Only on installments of insurers with online collection enabled.
perm.can_upload_receiptHint: It reaches you as a reply to confirm; nothing is marked paid by itself.
perm.can_report_statusHint: Every report reaches you as a reply to confirm.

labelPlaceholder: E.g. Sent to Juan over WhatsApp
revokeError: The link could not be revoked.
revokeConfirm: Anyone holding this link will lose access immediately.

list.title: Links created
list.empty: No links for this item yet.

gone.title: This link is no longer available
gone.hint: It may have expired, been revoked by the broker, or the address may be incomplete. Ask your broker for a new link.

error.title: We couldn't load the information
error.hint: Check your connection and try again in a few seconds.

return.title: You're back from the online payment
return.hint: If you completed the payment, the installment will update in a few minutes. There's nothing else to do.

insured.title: Your policy details
insured.lead: {{broker}} shares the status of your policy's installments with you.
insured.noInstallments: This policy has no installments recorded yet.
insured.emptyHint: Your broker hasn't recorded the policy for this link yet. Ask them to check.
insured.paidNote: This installment is paid. Thank you.
insured.payDirect: This installment is paid directly to {{insurer}}. See how to pay.
insured.payDirectNoInsurer: This installment is paid directly to the insurer. See how to pay.
insured.payDirectNoInstructions: This installment is paid directly to {{insurer}}; your broker will tell you how.
insured.payDirectNoInstructionsNoInsurer: This installment is paid directly to the insurer; your broker will tell you how.

pay.hint: We'll take you to the secure payment page.
pay.error: We couldn't open the online payment. You can pay following the insurer's instructions and then upload your receipt here.
pay.inReviewHint: You already sent a receipt for this installment: wait for your broker's review before paying again.

instructions.title: How to pay
instructions.leadNoInsurer: Pay the insurer directly with these details.
instructions.empty: The insurer hasn't published its payment details yet. Your broker will send them to you.
instructions.receipt_email: Email to send the receipt to

receipt.title: Upload receipt
receipt.hint: Your broker will review it and confirm the payment.
receipt.limits: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB.
receipt.currencyHint: Enter the amount as it appears on your receipt; if you paid in pesos, choose CLP.

errors.fileRequired: Choose the receipt you want to send.
errors.fileType: Upload the receipt as PDF, JPG or PNG.
errors.fileSize: The receipt exceeds the 10 MB limit.

receipt.pending: Receipt sent on {{date}} · being reviewed by your broker.
receipt.pendingNoDate: Receipt sent · being reviewed by your broker.

errors.future: The payment date can't be in the future.
errors.amountClp: Enter the amount in pesos, without decimals, e.g. 150.000.
errors.send: We couldn't send the information. Please try again.

insurer.title: Payment status inquiry
insurer.lead: {{broker}} asks you to confirm the payment status of these installments. You can report it right here.
insurer.leadReadOnly: {{broker}} shares the details of these installments with you.
insurer.noInstallments: There are no installments in this inquiry.
insurer.emptyHint: The policy for this link is no longer available. Please contact the broker.

statusHint.paid: The insurer received the full payment.
statusHint.partial: Only part of it was received.
statusHint.cancelled: The installment or the policy was voided.

report.commentPlaceholder: E.g. payment received by transfer, ref. 12345
report.note: The broker will review and confirm the information before recording it.

errors.partialAmount: Enter the amount received for a partial payment.

createdRevoked: You revoked this link: it no longer works and can't be sent. Create a new one if you need it.
